title: om.cut entry
description: The neutral host's cut marker: stored at the tip when a harness compacts its whole conversation; it is the compaction's firstKeptEntryId and the next compaction's range starts at it. Only the neutral store holds it. Source: memory/neutral/compact.go (CutMarker, Host.Compaction).

reason.description: The harness's reason (the generic payload's reason, a family hook's trigger); may be empty.
